annotations.title: Get District Insights for a Season by Category

description: Retrieve TBA insights scoped to one district for a season (or all-time with year 0) in a single category: leaderboard, streak, timeseries, game_stats, or clubs. Same shape as get_insights_by_category. Returns an empty list when the district has no insights in that category.

category.description: Insight category: 'leaderboard' (teams, events, or matches ranked by a value), 'streak' (consecutive achievements), 'timeseries' (values over weeks or years), 'game_stats' (per-season, per-week, and per-event game statistics; large), or 'clubs' (all-time milestone memberships).

district_abbreviation.description: FRC district abbreviation without a year (e.g., 'fim' for FIRST in Michigan, 'ne' for New England, 'chs' for Chesapeake, 'pnw' for Pacific Northwest, 'fit' for FIRST In Texas). Covers every season of the district, including renames such as 'mar' to 'fma'. Use get_districts to discover abbreviations.

anyOf.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

year.description: FRC season year the insights cover (1992 through next calendar year), or 0 for all-time insights across every season.

name: get_insights_for_district_by_category
title: Get District Insights for a Season by Category
